{{Quote|He is seldom actually on the battlefield, preferring to direct his pirates from a hidden base somewhere in the Parthovian Cluster.|[[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]], on [[Faarl]]|<ref name="WbC" />}}
The '''Parthovian Cluster''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. It contained the [[Faarlsun system/Legends|Faarlsun system]]. The Parthovian Cluster contained numerous uninhabited worlds, as well as several inhabited worlds rich in plunder but low in technology, something that the [[Pirate/Legends|Pirate]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Faarl]] took advantage of when he created his own secluded [[Faarl's empire|pirate empire]].
